move.speaker: Stephen Boyce
move.proposition: Hegesippus preserves a remembered succession of Jesus's physical relatives in Jerusalem leadership extending into the early second century.
move.sourceExcerpt: The family, the dynasty, the diadeakane if you were to use the word diadeakane, this dynasty of Jesus continued as leaders within the church of Jerusalem until about the time 110 AD. and justice was the first bishop of Jerusalem elected outside of this diadeakane. Therefore, Jesus was a real man who had real relatives that could be traced at least to the early sec second century
